basics.name: Vivian Ha
basics.label: AI/ML Research & Software Engineering Student
basics.summary: Software Engineering graduate with deep hands-on experience in applied machine learning, neural network design, and end-to-end model development. Current research focuses on deep learning and generative models for physical layer optimisation in wireless systems, with demonstrated ability to design, train, and deploy models from simulation to embedded hardware. Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals, supported by industry R&D experience in translating technical research into commercial solutions.
